intro.title: You already know
intro.note: Phrasal verbs 1 gave you the everyday ones — around the house (turn on, turn off, tidy up, wash up), the day itself (wake up, go out, come back) and small jobs (fill in, pick up, pay back). None of them comes back as a new word here: these thirty-six are the next thirty-six, for work, travel and people. The grammar of the split — turn the light off — is b1_phrasal_verbs, not this unit.
intro.note_cz: Phrasal verbs 1 dal ty každodenní — kolem domu (turn on, turn off, tidy up, wash up), den sám (wake up, go out, come back) a drobné úkoly (fill in, pick up, pay back). Žádné z nich se tu neučí znovu: těchto třicet šest je další třicítka, pro práci, cestování a lidi. Gramatika rozdělení — turn the light off — patří do b1_phrasal_verbs, ne sem.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: These are **pack 2**. Pack 1 has the everyday ones (turn on, tidy up, pick up) and b1_phrasal_verbs has the grammar of the split. Nothing here repeats those.
intro.note_cz: Tohle je druhý balík. První má běžné domácí, gramatiku řeší b1_phrasal_verbs.

sentences.en: Please sort out the papers before the meeting starts.
sentences.cz: Než začne schůzka, dej prosím ty papíry do pořádku.
accepts: Please sort out the papers before the meeting starts

sentences.en: Can you hand in the report before the meeting starts on Friday?
sentences.cz: Můžeš odevzdat tu zprávu, než v pátek začne schůzka?
accepts: Can you hand in the report before the meeting starts on Friday?

sentences.en: I will call back this afternoon when the meeting finishes.
sentences.cz: Zavolám zpátky odpoledne, až schůzka skončí.
accepts: I will call back this afternoon when the meeting finishes
I'll call back this afternoon when the meeting finishes

sentences.en: Please put back the keys where you found them.
sentences.cz: Vrať prosím klíče tam, kde jsi je našel.
accepts: Please put back the keys where you found them

sentences.en: The company will take on ten new people although the office is already full.
sentences.cz: Firma přijme deset nových lidí, i když je kancelář už teď plná.
accepts: The company will take on ten new people although the office is already full

sentences.en: She will take over the office when the manager leaves.
sentences.cz: Až vedoucí odejde, převezme kancelář ona.
accepts: She will take over the office when the manager leaves

sentences.en: They want to set up a new company in Brno because the rent is lower there.
sentences.cz: Chtějí v Brně založit novou firmu, protože je tam nižší nájem.
accepts: They want to set up a new company in Brno because the rent is lower there

sentences.en: We must work out how much the trip will cost before we book the hotel.
sentences.cz: Musíme spočítat, kolik ten výlet bude stát, než zamluvíme hotel.

sentences.en: The office has to deal with a hundred emails a day, but nobody answers the phone.
sentences.cz: Kancelář musí denně vyřídit sto e-mailů, ale nikdo nezvedá telefon.

sentences.en: We carry on when the others go home.

accepts: We carry on when the others go home

sentences.en: He wants to give up smoking this year because his father was ill.

sentences.en: The police will look into the missing money although the company said nothing.

sentences.en: We look round the town before we find the hotel.

accepts: We look round the town before we find the hotel

sentences.en: I drop in on my grandmother every Thursday because she lives near the office.
sentences.cz: Každý čtvrtek se zastavím u babičky, protože bydlí blízko kanceláře.

sentences.en: We see off our friends at the station when they travel to Poland.

sentences.en: I often run into my old teacher in the shop, but she never remembers me.

sentences.en: They go back to Poland every summer although the children grew up here.

sentences.en: The snow will hold up every train in the country if it does not stop.
sentences.cz: Sníh zdrží každý vlak v zemi, pokud nepřestane padat.
accepts: The snow will hold up every train in the country if it does not stop

sentences.en: Can you drop off the keys at the office before you go home?

sentences.en: We end up in a small hotel near the river because the campsite was full.

sentences.en: The bus will head for the airport at seven, but we should leave earlier.

sentences.en: We pack up the car on Friday evening so that we can leave early.

sentences.en: I have to put up with the noise from the street although the rent is high.
sentences.cz: Musím snášet hluk z ulice, i když je nájem vysoký.
accepts: I have to put up with the noise from the street although the rent is high

sentences.en: A short walk will cheer up the children when the weather is bad.
sentences.cz: Krátká procházka děti rozveselí, když je špatné počasí.

sentences.en: The teacher will tell off the boy who broke the window.

sentences.en: My grandmother helped to bring up all four children after my grandfather left.

sentences.en: Do not look down on people who work at night.

sentences.en: She will fall for anybody who makes her laugh.

sentences.en: We catch up on the news every Sunday because nobody has time in the week.

sentences.cz: Chce tu dívku z obchodu pozvat na rande, ale nikdy nic neřekne.
